1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgement and order dated 03.11.1998 passed by Sri Hari Singh, IIIrd Additional Sessions Judge, Basti in Criminal Appeal No. 17 of 1988, dismissing appeal and affirming the conviction and sentence imposed by Sri Prem Bahadur, Special Judicial Magistrate (Economic Offence)/ Judicial Magistrate IInd, Basti in Criminal Case No. 8 of 1988 under Sections 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text: Special Judicial Magistrate (Economic Offence)/ Judicial Magistrate IInd, Basti
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Being aggrieved, revisionist preferred present revision.

3. Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
